_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. elektron.se declares readable --thedock-*/--tdc-* custom properties on :root (raw/css-vars.json); they are var-referenced where the measured surface paints the same value, and measured computed values (raw/components-computed.json) cover the #cccccc/#757575/#333333/#808080 greys, the inverted outline-button and focus-ring state layers, the Neue Haas Grotesk Text/Display and digi one v2 / Analog One V2 families, the all-square radii and the 7px space rhythm. The site paints one dark theme; the roles live in the dark set.

text.source: css-var --thedock-font (raw/css-vars.json); computed fontFamily of nav-link default agrees
text.description: Body, navigation and heading-adjacent text: Neue Haas Grotesk Text Pro.

display.source: css-var --tdc-font-heading (raw/css-vars.json); computed fontFamily of section-h2 default agrees
display.description: Display headings and the big footer/accordion/menu links: Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro.

button.description: The digi one v2 face every block-button label paints (the block-button text style), with text-transform capitals on the outline actions.

search.description: The Analog One V2. face the header search field paints.

mono.description: The declared monospace stack for code and technical text.

regular.description: Body and display weight (400) — the whole face set.

medium.description: The 500 weight on display headings and explore rows.

error.source: css-var --tdc-danger (raw/css-vars.json) resolves to a color-mix over this base hue
error.description: The declared danger red: --tdc-danger paints color-mix(in srgb, #d63638 70%, currentColor).

success.source: css-var --tdc-success (raw/css-vars.json) resolves to a color-mix over this base hue
success.description: The declared success green: --tdc-success paints color-mix(in srgb, #1e7a3c 70%, currentColor).

s2.source: css-var --tdc-space-2 (raw/css-vars.json); computed gap of nav-link default agrees (raw/components-computed.json)

s5.description: 17.5px — the button's horizontal padding and the search field's.

s8.description: 44px — the login field's right padding for the inline icon.

s9.description: 70px — the page-title indent under the hanging bullet.

none.source: css-var --tdc-radius (raw/css-vars.json); the computed border radius of buttons, fields and drawers agrees (raw/components-computed.json)
none.description: Square: every button, field, card and drawer paints 0px corners.

search.description: The only rounded control found: the 7px header search field.

control.description: The 2px stroke of the outline block-buttons (EXPLORE, ADD TO CART, SUBMIT, CONTINUE SHOPPING).

search.source: computed borderTopWidth of search-field default (raw/components-computed.json): 1px solid #151515 — a self-coloured stroke

drawer.source: painted shadow on the cart drawer's panel ancestor (raw/components-computed.json)
drawer.description: The -7px/35px drop the cart and account drawers cast leftward over the page.

standard.description: The site's own easing on colour, transform and header transitions.

bounce.description: The slight-overshoot ease the mobile header height transition uses.

sweep.source: declared transition in the same-origin theme sheets (raw/components-computed.json _meta.sheets)
sweep.description: The dramatic ease the 1.5s line/word reveal animations declare.

transition-control.description: The 0.3s ease on link colour, border, background and opacity. (border)

transition-sweep.description: The 0.4s background-size ease that drives the underline-sweep and the outline-button fill. (background-size)

transition-header.description: The 0.8s box-shadow bounce the header takes. (box-shadow)
